prompt:
Edit this CLEAN TUNER three-panel UI design study. Preserve the exact premium champagne frosted metal, cream glass, layout, all labels, all numeric readings, and the three states. Change ONLY the arc meters in all panels.

The user wants each note to occupy a visible RANGE rather than being represented by a line. Remove ALL black radial tick marks, including every fine tick, every long note-center tick and endpoint tick. Replace the ticked ruler with a slim, softly translucent segmented curved ribbon, following the exact same upper arch geometry. Three continuous note zones, each with its note name centered above its zone: G♯ / A / A♯ in first two panels; B / C / C♯ in third. Central zone centered on the top apex, neighboring zones to its left and right. Boundaries lie HALFWAY BETWEEN note labels, NEVER directly under a label. Use only a subtle change of translucent ivory tone and two tiny hairline gaps between zones to show boundaries. Keep ribbon shallow and visually light, around 16px thick at this image resolution, NOT a chunky metal bridge, no extrusion, no rainbow hues. Each zone has breadth, not a narrow line.

Retain just ONE actual-pitch indicator per screen as a very fine short amber luminous marker crossing the ribbon: first screen -18 ct slightly left of the middle of the central A zone; second and third screens 0 ct at middle of their central zone. Absolutely no static black center line behind these moving indicators. Warm amber glow spreads softly across the current note's central zone with brightest area at the actual-pitch indicator, neighbors faintly illuminated. In first screen the glow maximum is off-center left within A's zone; in accurate screens symmetric about center. The whole central zone does NOT mean in tune; keep '-18 ct / FLAT' vs '0 ct / IN TUNE' text unchanged. No added explanations or controls. Maintain beautiful crisp typography and modern warm understated analog gear aesthetic.
note: Concept only. Zones indicate nearest-note classification, not acceptable tuning tolerance. Generated edit omitted small octave identifiers; restore A4 and C5 in implementation.
